comparison.objective: Insert both ends of a short patch cord into separate tester jacks.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual cable management and constrained connector insertion without unseating the first plug.
comparison.success_condition: Both plugs at least 15 mm deep, tester units unmoved and plugs released.
comparison.reason: Tests dual insertion under cable tension; it lacks unlocking, fine setting changes, tightening torque and iterative dynamic observation.
